Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 성공적으로 의뢰를 끝낸 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 앞으로도 열심히 노력하자고 의욕을 드러낸다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> expressed the determination to keep improving.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を無事に終えた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、これからも頑張ろうと意欲を見せる。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 顺利完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>充满干劲地说今后也要继续努力。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 順利完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>充滿幹勁地說今後也要繼續努力。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, qui a terminé la mission avec succès, exprime sa détermination à continuer à faire de son mieux.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> den Auftrag erfolgreich abgeschlossen hat, zeigt er/sie sich motiviert, weiterhin hart zu arbeiten.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, tras completar la misión con éxito, muestra su determinación de seguir esforzándose.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: O(A) <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> completou a missão com sucesso e mostra determinação para continuar se esforçando.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ทำภารกิจสำเร็จแล้ว แสดงความมุ่งมั่นที่จะพยายามอย่างหนักต่อไป
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menunjukkan tekad untuk terus berusaha keras di masa depan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thành công, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thể hiện sự quyết tâm sẽ tiếp tục nỗ lực hết mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक सफल कार्य के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने आगे भी सुधार करते रहने का दृढ़ संकल्प व्यक्त किया।
